'''Geoff Snider Geoff's Epilogue to Last Tourney (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Geoff Snider]] posted on DeckTech on 29 March 2001 about [[March 2001 Illinois tournament (28 March)]].<ref name="tr-d1976">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-29-geoffs-epilogue-to-last-tourneyd1976/ geoffs-epilogue-to-last-tourney], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 29 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-29-geoffs-epilogue-to-last-tourneyd1976/ GitHub Pages].</ref> A short note by Geoff Snider defending his report [[Geoff Snider March 2001 Illinois tournament (28 March) report (tournament report)]]: the Wednesday event was a real, sanctioned tournament, run during the local high-school spring break by a tournament director who is a teacher and listed on decipher.com.

== Original report ==

'''geoffs-epilogue-to-last-tourney'''
* '''Author:''' Geoff "gsiva" Snider
* '''Published:''' Mar 29, 2001

<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
  hey, that WAS a real tournament, and just because it took place yesterday (wednesday) doesn’t mean jack sh1t.  alot of the kids around here have spring break from their high school, so one of the TD’s who happens to be a teacher decided to run a wednesday tournament.  that one is totally legit, and if you don’t think so, then check out the "tournaments" section on decipher.com.



blah
</nowiki></div>
